title: Virgo Zodiac Sign: Personality, Love, Career & Compatibility
intro: Virgo (August 23 – September 22) is the thoughtful earth sign ruled by Mercury. Smart, helpful and detail-oriented, Virgo makes the world a little more organized every day.
personality: Virgo notices what others miss. They love useful knowledge, clean systems and doing things well. Modest and kind, they show love by helping and fixing. Their high standards can turn into self-criticism, so they need reminders that 'good' is often good enough.
love: Virgo takes love seriously and shows it through actions: planning, caring and supporting. They open up slowly, but once they trust, they are loyal and attentive partners.
career: Virgo excels in health, research, editing, accounting, data, planning and any job where accuracy and service matter.
friendship: Virgo is the friend with the plan, the list and the honest advice that actually helps.

faq.q: What is the Virgo personality like?
faq.ans: Virgo is organized, helpful, analytical and has high standards.

faq.q: Who is Virgo most compatible with?
faq.ans: Virgo tends to match best with Taurus, Capricorn and Cancer.

faq.q: What is the lucky stone of Virgo?
faq.ans: Sapphire is a classic lucky stone for Virgo.
